title: Slice 3 (Install) phase-2a: red-gate seed + build (static-member half; generated members split to post-Slice-2)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
BUILT TO GREEN (host subagent; kickoff --container blocked by image bugs, #837). install_slice_red_gate 18/18, init 7/7 preserved, workspace 179 green, clippy -D warnings clean, mdatron clean, oracle unmodified. Committed f5c3e837 on slice-3-install-build; GitHub PR #17.

BUILD-TIME AMBIGUITY RESOLUTIONS (recorded per methodology):
1. GENERATED-MANIFEST ONTOLOGY (worth operator confirmation): the installed-artifact-manifest schema is a closed class/source vocabulary (hooks/servers/commands/plugins/git-hooks/identity/statusline/rules) with NO class for schemas/patterns/registry-data/supplements/workflows/DESIGN. So init generates the manifest over only the deployed artifacts in that ontology — 28 .claude/commands/vsdd-*.md as command-listing + the statusline as statusline-wiring (29 entries); the data/config payloads are drift-tracked by init-manifest.json + their schema pairs (stated in the generated file's body). Validates, non-empty, deterministic, differs from vsdd-cli's own. If REQ-15 intended a broader manifest, that's a schema-vocabulary extension (its own change).
2. sha256 stays WHOLE-FILE (init.rs sibling test #4 asserts manifest.sha256==sha256(full file)); section-managed drift judged by comparing the managed REGION directly (no region-sha record) -> conservative Conflict, never silent overwrite.
3. ManagedFileDrifted kept as the Conflict-without-force-without-TTY outcome (matches design); interactive prompt in the binary so the core never reads stdin under cargo test.
